svg.title: The crowding problem
svg.desc: Each dot is one of the 820 occupations in the evaluation. Under conventional advice 7.3% of first recommendations go to the ten most recommended jobs. Version 1, which ranks moves one worker at a time, sends 27.7%, including 45 occupations to Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials. Version 2 caps each destination at 8 and brings the share down to 9.8%.

g.text: Version 1: one worker at a time
Version 2: a cap of 8 per job
Share of first recommendations that go to the ten
most recommended jobs. Each dot is one of the 820 occupations.
45 occupations sent to one small, shrinking job
Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
